meta.title: Vink: AI document data extraction for operations teams
meta.description: Vink reads any PDF, typed, scanned or handwritten, and turns it into clean data for your systems. You only check what it isn't sure about. 20 free pages.

og.title: Document. Vink. Done.
og.alt: Vink. Document. Vink. Done. Any PDF in, clean data out.

hero.subtitle: Vink reads any PDF, typed, scanned or handwritten, and turns it into clean data for your systems. You only check what it isn't sure about.
hero.screenLabel: The Vink review screen with one value that needs review

video.title: One PDF in, clean data out.
video.subtitle: Thirty seconds, from paper work order to back office.
video.label: A 30-second film of a handwritten work order going through Vink

journey.title: What happens to one document.
journey.subtitle: Four stops, from the PDF on your desk to the data in your system. You only step in at the third.

arrives.title: Any PDF. Even handwriting.
arrives.body: Typed, scanned or handwritten, one page or a bundle of papers. No templates to build.
arrives.intake: Upload it or email it in. Drop several PDFs at once, or give a Form its own email address. PDF attachments, up to 20 pages each.

reads.title: Every value, with its source.
reads.body: Each value shows what was read and on which page. Most documents are done in under a minute.

check.title: You only check what's unsure.
check.body: Every value shows what was read and on which page. Vink flags what it isn't sure about, and nothing goes out until you approve it.

lands.title: Straight into your systems.
lands.body: Approved data goes to your system as clean JSON, and Auto-Send handles the documents Vink is sure about.

connect.title: Two ways to connect it.
connect.subtitle: Your developer connects one webhook, or we build the connection for you.

dev.title: One signed webhook.
dev.body: JSON keyed by your own Fields, an HMAC signature, retries and a test-send.

service.title: We connect it for you.
service.body: Tell us which system your data needs to reach. We build and test the connection, for a fixed price agreed up front.
service.point1: Your ERP, accounting package, spreadsheet or database
service.point3: One price, agreed before we start

pricing.title: Every plan includes everything.
pricing.subtitle: You only choose how many pages. Prices excl. VAT.
pricing.free: Start with 20 free pages. No credit card.

wrong.q: What if Vink reads something wrong?
wrong.a: You see every value Vink isn't sure about, with what it read and on which page. Nothing is sent until someone approves it.

messy.q: Our documents are messy, or handwritten.
messy.a: Try it on your own documents. The first 20 pages are free, no credit card needed.

developer.a: We'll build the connection to your system for you. It's a paid service with a price agreed up front.

templates.q: Do I need to set up templates?
templates.a: No. Describe your fields, or let Vink propose them from one example. After that, Vink matches every new document to your fields by itself, whatever the layout. It reads PDFs of up to 20 pages.
